briefs.claim_en: The image in this post shows people celebrating India's Chandrayaan-3 Moon landing.
briefs.brief_en: Multiple news outlets and image archives confirm widespread celebrations across India following the successful Chandrayaan-3 Moon landing on August 23, 2023. Mid-day.com, Getty Images, Alamy, The National News, and Al Jazeera published photos and reports of citizens, party leaders, and the general public celebrating with Indian flags, dancing, and watching live streams of the event. While some unrelated visuals and AI-generated images were circulated online regarding the Chandrayaan-3 mission, these pertained to different content, such as alleged live visuals from the moon's surface or a misattributed BBC report, not the general celebration images.
